summary: October 16, 2025 automation hub fixes: global galaxy team role migration during post-migrate, a constraint violation in migrations, and aap-gateway-manage migrate_service_data failing with 'Role definition content type must be null to assign globally'.
questions: Role definition content type must be null to assign globally
Galaxy team role migration error during upgrade

answer_card.title: 'Role definition content type must be null to assign globally'
answer_card.answer_md: This error from `aap-gateway-manage migrate_service_data` came from automation hub permissions that failed validation during the post-migrate upgrade step. It was fixed in the **October 16, 2025** AAP 2.6 patch (AAP-55639), along with a global galaxy team role migration issue (AAP-55304) and a migration constraint violation (AAP-55309).
